title: A Colony for the Echo
author: I. M. Brightwater
blurb: Quentin Montrose, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
